Vilmorin-Andrieux catalogues acquired to BRACKET the introduction of the
large smooth ('lisse', ribless) tomato. Retrieved 2026-08-30, public domain.
PDFs are image-only: term-search the *.ocr.txt.

WHY THESE FIVE:
1874, 1874-75 : establish ABSENCE of any 'lisse' tomato through 1874-75.
1881 : a supplement with NO tomato entry at all (verified zero).
1882, 1882-83 : show 'rouge grosse lisse. T. Trophy' STILL marked (Nouv.),
proving the (Nouv.) marker persists for years and therefore
does NOT date a variety's introduction.
